name: How do I create a budget for an investment property renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I create a budget for an investment property renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by getting detailed estimates for each renovation task from contractors. Research material costs and factor in permits, inspections, and potential unexpected issues. It's crucial to set aside a contingency fund, typically 10-20% of your total budget, for unforeseen problems. Prioritize renovations that add the most value or are essential for safety and functionality. Track all expenses carefully to stay within your budget and avoid overspending on non-essential upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Create a budget by obtaining detailed contractor estimates, researching material costs, including permits, and allocating a 10-20% contingency fund for unexpected issues.
